title: RSI-Master: Structuring Experiments to Guide Autonomous Model Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2609.35561v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to enable AI systems to participate in improving their own capabilities. A concrete pathway is autonomous model development, where agents iteratively explore post-training strategies to improve a base model. This setting faces two challenges: agents may exploit open-ended experimental actions through hacking, and repeated experimentation may lead to strategy lock-in, where an early direction is refined rather than reconsidered. We introduce RSI-Master, which addresses the two challenges at two levels: regularize step-wise actions, avoiding hacking behaviors, and promote well-structured exploration of research directions, avoiding strategy lock-in. translated_title: RSI-Master：构建结构化实验以引导自主模型改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在使AI系统能够参与提升自身的能力。一条具体路径是自主模型开发，即智能体迭代地探索后训练策略来改进基础模型。这一设定面临两个挑战：智能体可能通过“作弊”（hacking）方式利用开放式实验操作，以及反复实验可能导致策略锁定，即早期的研究方向被不断细化而不再被重新审视。我们提出了RSI-Master，它在两个层面应对这两个挑战：通过规范逐步实验操作来避免作弊行为，并通过促进对研究方向的良好结构化探索来避免策略锁定。RSI-Master由两部分组成：实验操作系统，它实现规范化的实验操作并维护持久、可追溯的实验记录；以及评审引导的研究编排，它以动态增长的方式组织工作者与评审者。
tldr: RSI-Master通过实验操作系统规范化实验操作并保留可追溯记录，结合评审引导的研究编排实现结构化探索，从而在自主模型开发中同时避免作弊行为与策略锁定。
en_tdlr: RSI-Master guides autonomous model improvement by combining an Experiment OS that regularizes experimental actions with persistent traceable records and a reviewer-guided research orchestration, thereby preventing both hacking behaviors and strategy lock-in.
